resumo: A large evacuation and humanitarian mission is under way in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky on the Dnipro River. titulo: UN reports sharp increase in opium poppy cultivation and production in Afghanistan

titulo: UN: Large-scale return of Afghan refugees strains Afghan economy
